scoring_justification: Deterministic analytical model; checker recomputes expected values from the same formulas and parameters, compares agent's predicted forces to recomputed values within tolerance (0.01 nN).

outputs.description: Predicted capsid breaking force for four DNA packaging conditions (empty, 78%, 94%, 100% WT) computed from the osmotic indentation model.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the expected forces using the same analytical model and parameters, then compares the agent's predictions against those recomputed values.

steps.description: Agent's predicted breaking forces must match recomputed values from the analytical model within tolerance.
